meta.portfolio_disclaimer: Independent portfolio project. The company and dataset are fictional and simulate a realistic retail analytics assignment.
meta.source_note: Cleaned weekly POS, tracked inventory snapshots, supplier purchase orders and store targets.

actions.issue: Escalate North Coast Cold Stores cold-chain delivery failures
actions.driver: Repeated late and incomplete deliveries in affected coastal stores
actions.recommended_action: Agree a two-week recovery plan, reserve daily allocation for the highest-loss chilled SKUs and track every missed delivery.
actions.evidence_status: Observed association; operating cause requires supplier confirmation

actions.issue: Protect KwaZulu-Natal priority stores from repeated stockouts
actions.driver: Loss exposure concentrated in a small set of tracked store-SKU combinations
actions.recommended_action: Introduce twice-weekly exception reviews for the highest-loss stores and move available stock across nearby branches.

actions.driver: Deep winter household and personal-care promotions reduce realised gross margin
actions.recommended_action: Review campaign depth by SKU, require a minimum realised-margin threshold and test narrower offers before renewal.
actions.evidence_status: Observed margin association; incremental demand not experimentally isolated

actions.issue: Rebalance reorder buffers for chilled core lines
actions.driver: Short shelf-life items have little tolerance for delivery slippage
actions.recommended_action: Adjust safety stock on the most material lines after checking expiry exposure and available cold-room capacity.
actions.evidence_status: Recommended control; benefit is an illustrative opportunity

actions.issue: Track supplier service and availability together
actions.driver: Sales-only reporting masks delivery reliability and unmet demand
actions.recommended_action: Publish one weekly exception pack with weighted availability, fill rate, late orders, loss exposure and accountable owners.
actions.evidence_status: Reporting improvement; no standalone savings claimed

quality.issue: Mixed ISO and day-first date formats
quality.detection_method: Regex profile and parsed-date exception check
quality.cleaning_decision: Parse known ISO and DD/MM/YYYY patterns explicitly
quality.business_rule: Reporting week is always a valid Monday
quality.final_treatment: Converted every recoverable date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD

quality.detection_method: Compare key length and stripped key to store master
quality.cleaning_decision: Trim leading and trailing whitespace before joins
quality.business_rule: Valid store keys follow ST plus three digits
quality.final_treatment: Keys normalised and matched to DimStores

quality.cleaning_decision: Strip percent sign and divide by 100
quality.business_rule: DiscountRate must be a decimal between 0 and 0.60
quality.final_treatment: Parsed to decimal; source financial amounts retained

quality.cleaning_decision: Recover from CostOfGoodsSold divided by Units
quality.business_rule: Recorded transaction totals take priority over standard product costs
quality.final_treatment: Restored unit cost without changing transaction totals

quality.issue: Blank promotion descriptions on non-promoted rows
quality.detection_method: Null scan checked against zero discount
quality.cleaning_decision: Assign No promotion only when DiscountRate equals zero
quality.business_rule: A missing promotion label never implies a discount
quality.final_treatment: Filled non-promoted blanks; no value changes

quality.issue: Store keys absent from approved store master
quality.cleaning_decision: Quarantine rows; do not guess store identity
quality.business_rule: Commercial reporting includes approved mapped stores only
quality.final_treatment: Excluded from clean fact and saved to quarantine_sales.csv

quality.issue: Product keys absent from approved assortment
quality.cleaning_decision: Quarantine rows; product identity cannot be recovered reliably
quality.business_rule: Measures exclude unapproved or unmapped products
quality.final_treatment: Excluded from clean fact and saved to quarantine_sales.csv

quality.cleaning_decision: Retain first identical record; investigate conflicting duplicates

quality.business_rule: One approved snapshot per inventory record ID

quality.detection_method: Compare source key against trimmed store master
quality.cleaning_decision: Trim before supplier, store and product joins
quality.business_rule: Inventory scope must match an approved store
quality.final_treatment: Normalised keys and validated all relationships

quality.issue: Inconsistent category labels in product master
quality.detection_method: Distinct category profile against six approved categories
quality.business_rule: Category labels must match the approved trading hierarchy
quality.final_treatment: Mapped all variants to one canonical category

quality.issue: Missing supplier mappings in product master
quality.detection_method: Null scan and supplier match from approved product crosswalk
quality.cleaning_decision: Recover supplier from controlled ProductID crosswalk
quality.business_rule: Every product has exactly one primary supplier
quality.final_treatment: Restored mappings and validated supplier referential integrity

quality.issue: Duplicate product master records with spacing differences
quality.cleaning_decision: Keep the first approved master record
quality.business_rule: ProductID is the unique product dimension key

quality.issue: Region naming variants in store master
quality.cleaning_decision: Map approved aliases through the region crosswalk
quality.business_rule: Each store maps to exactly one authorised region

quality.issue: Negative sales records representing valid customer returns
quality.detection_method: RecordType, negative unit and signed-value reconciliation
quality.cleaning_decision: Retain legitimate returns rather than deleting negative values
quality.business_rule: Returns reverse revenue, units, discount and cost consistently
quality.final_treatment: Kept all valid returns in commercial totals
